<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="23" y="21" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="15" x2="326" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="13" x2="331" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="11" x2="336" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="16" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="356" y1="12" x2="360" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="16" x2="356" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="369" y="11" width="18" height="10" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="13" width="13" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="388" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,58 22,67 31,76" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">PHONE VERIFICATION</text>
    <line x1="0" y1="91" x2="390" y2="91" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="139" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My number is</text>
    <text x="30" y="172" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">We'll send you a verification code</text>

    <text x="30" y="212" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">COUNTRY</text>
    <rect x="30" y="220" width="112" height="42" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="45" y="247" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">United States</text>
    <polyline points="124,237 130,243 136,237" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <text x="157" y="212" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">PHONE NUMBER</text>
    <rect x="157" y="220" width="203" height="42" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="173" y="247" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">+1 415 555 0138</text>

    <line x1="30" y1="278" x2="360" y2="278" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="30" y="302" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Standard message and data rates may apply.</text>

    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="330" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="358" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>

    <text x="195" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
    <text x="195" y="427" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Terms and Privacy Policy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- App navigation above keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="473" width="390" height="75" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="473" x2="390" y2="473" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,497 49,488 59,497 59,508 39,508" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="35,497 49,485 63,497" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="128" cy="496" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="122,496 126,500 134,491" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="128" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="190" y="487" width="20" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="196,502 194,508 201,502" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <circle cx="196" cy="494" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="202" cy="494" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="200" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MESSAGES</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="306" cy="494" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="306" cy="505" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="306" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Native numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="548" width="390" height="296" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <!-- row 1 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="7" y="555" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="7" y="554" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="66" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">1</text>
      <text x="66" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393"></text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="135" y="555" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="135" y="554" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="195" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">2</text>
      <text x="195" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">ABC</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="263" y="555" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="263" y="554" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="322" y="582" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">3</text>
      <text x="322" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">DEF</text>
    </g>

    <!-- row 2 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="7" y="620" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="7" y="619" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="66" y="647" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
      <text x="66" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">GHI</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="135" y="620" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="135" y="619" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="195" y="647" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
      <text x="195" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">JKL</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="263" y="620" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="263" y="619" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="322" y="647" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
      <text x="322" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">MNO</text>
    </g>

    <!-- row 3 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="7" y="685" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="7" y="684" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="66" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
      <text x="66" y="730" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">PQRS</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="135" y="685" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="135" y="684" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="195" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
      <text x="195" y="730" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">TUV</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="263" y="685" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="263" y="684" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="322" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
      <text x="322" y="730" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">WXYZ</text>
    </g>

    <!-- row 4 -->
    <g>
      <rect x="7" y="750" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="7" y="749" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="66" y="777" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">*</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="135" y="750" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="135" y="749" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <text x="195" y="777" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
      <text x="195" y="795" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">+</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="263" y="750" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
      <rect x="263" y="749" width="119" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <polyline points="310,776 320,776 326,770 326,784 320,778 310,778" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="145" y="828" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
